toast.$description: Transient status messages. Status is never carried by color alone: every accent below requires an icon and text naming the condition, because a toast is often the only notice a user receives and it disappears on its own.

surface.$description: Toast background — elevated so it separates from the page beneath.

border.$description: Hairline edge, so the toast holds its shape on a busy surface.

action.$description: Inline action ("Undo"). Must remain a real control, never the only way to recover. Uses accent.ink, not accent.default: this is gold TEXT, and pure Crown Gold measures 1.44:1 on a light toast surface. accent.ink is the per-theme gold that is legible as text.

layer.$description: Above dialogs, so a toast raised by a dialog action stays visible.

gap.$description: Gap between icon, message, and action.

max-width.$description: Keeps a toast readable in one or two lines on a wide viewport.

exit-duration.$description: Exit — faster than the entrance, so a dismissal feels answered.

positive.$description: Success. Requires a success icon and text.

negative.$description: Error. Requires an icon, text, and a way to retry or recover.

warning.$description: Warning. Requires an icon and text naming the risk.

info.$description: Neutral information. Requires an icon and text.
